bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address}) over Bluetooth? Home Assistant will hold the soundbar's control connection, so Creative's app cannot connect while it does (turn off "Hold connection" to let it in).

user.description: Pick the soundbar's Bluetooth control device ("Control for MF8400").

abort.already_configured: This soundbar is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Katana V2X control device is in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Katana V2X control channel.

data.stream_timeout_s: Screen sync hand-over (seconds without frames before the lights go off)

data_description.allow_unconfirmed: Controls whose commands were decoded from Creative's app but not yet confirmed working by you are refused until this is on. Turn it on to run the live checklist.
data_description.stream_timeout_s: At least 10 s: the PC re-sends an unchanged colour every 5 s, so a shorter hand-over would blink the lights.

not_in_range.message: The soundbar ({address}) is not in range of a Bluetooth adapter that can connect to it.

link_not_ready.message: The Bluetooth link to the soundbar is not ready yet: {error}

frame_too_long.message: The command is {size} bytes, more than this Bluetooth link accepts ({limit}).

write_failed.message: Sending to the soundbar over Bluetooth failed: {error}

no_answer.message: The soundbar did not answer command {frame}.

no_reply.message: The soundbar acknowledged command {frame} but sent no data back.

untested_firmware.message: The soundbar runs firmware {found}, but only {tested} has been tested, so every change is refused. Reading still works.

unconfirmed.message: “{control}” has not been confirmed working on this soundbar yet. Turn on “Allow unconfirmed controls” in the integration's options to try it.

output_unknown.message: It is not known yet whether the speakers or the headphones are active, so it is unclear which side to change. Re-read the state and try again.

eq_bands_unknown.message: The current equalizer bands are not known yet. Re-read the state and try again.

volume_unknown.message: The current volume is not known yet. Re-read the state and try again.

no_loaded_entry.message: No Sound Blaster Katana V2X is set up and loaded.

several_entries.message: More than one soundbar is set up: say which one with config_entry_id.

reconnect_failed.message: Could not reconnect to the soundbar yet (it keeps trying): {error}

untested_firmware.title: Katana firmware is not the tested version
untested_firmware.description: The soundbar reports firmware {found}, but the integration was built against {tested}. Every write is refused until the commands are re-verified on this firmware; reads still work. Do not install firmware updates from Creative's app if you want to keep control from Home Assistant.

stream_frame.name: Stream frame
stream_frame.description: Show one screen-sync colour (the PC uses the /api/sb_katana/stream endpoint instead, which records nothing).

config_entry_id.name: Soundbar
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one soundbar is set up.
